description: Get one SMS conversation with its message history (up to message_limit most recent messages), identified by its conversation ID. Returns the contact, your phone number, the message count, any stored metadata, and the messages.

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation to fetch, from list_conversations.

message_limit.description: How many of the most recent messages to include.

name: get_conversation

outputSchema.description: One SMS conversation with its message history.

agentId.description: ID of the agent on this thread, or null.

id.description: The conversation's unique ID (use as conversation_id).

lastMessageAt.description: Time of the most recent message (ISO 8601), or null.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the latest message.

messages.description: The conversation's messages, up to message_limit.

metadata.description: Custom state stored on the conversation, or null.

participant.description: The external contact's number in E.164 format.

phoneNumberId.description: ID of your phone number in this thread.

title: Get Conversation
